item.title: Insights: Chris Hansen gives more details on Dickinson Co. child exploitation sting operation
item.description: In October of 2025, the Dickinson County Sheriff's Office conducted a child exploitation sting operation in Iron Mountain. It led to the arrests of seven men who thought they would be meeting with a minor. Instead, they were met with law enforcement and Chris Hansen. Streaming platform TruBlu has released the first episode of Takedown with Chris Hansen involving that operation.
